items.title: Boris FX releases Silhouette 2027
items.excerpt: The VFX rotoscoping and paint tool adds new machine-learning nodes such as Body ML that generate editable roto shapes, and a Video Inpaint ML node to speed up object removal.
items.rationale: A shipping release of an industry-standard roto/paint tool: ML nodes that output editable roto shapes and inpaint objects change how VFX artists work tomorrow (assigned to movies only by the brief).

items.title: AI Film 'Gods Don't Give Gifts' Deemed Ineligible by Academy for Best Animated Feature Oscar
items.excerpt: The Academy has ruled Gossip Goblin's AI-generated feature 'Gods Don't Give Gifts' ineligible for the Best Animated Feature Oscar race, ahead of its Dec. 4 theatrical release.
items.rationale: Follow-up with a new concrete decision: the Academy's first eligibility ruling against an AI-generated feature in Best Animated Feature, a precedent for anyone planning an awards run with gen-AI work.

items.title: How We Built CorridorKey 2.0 | Live Demo & Q&A
items.excerpt: Niko and developer Zach Harris break down how Corridor built CorridorKey 2.0, the AI keying tool running on a custom-trained model, with a live demo.
items.rationale: A new version of an AI keying tool, demoed live by its builders. Keying is everyday compositing work, and the demo shows what the custom model can and cannot pull.

items.title: 심형래 감독, AI 기술로 깨운 '디 워: NEW HOPE' 2027년 재개봉 예고
items.excerpt: 심형래 감독이 힉스필드AI와 협력해 AI 영상 기술로 30분 분량의 미공개 액션 장면을 추가한 '디 워: NEW HOPE'를 2027년 국내외 재개봉한다고 밝혔다.
items.rationale: A new announcement with a trailer: a known Korean feature gets 30 minutes of new AI-generated action (with Higgsfield) for a 2027 re-release, a new kind of AI re-edit of a legacy film.

items.title: AI filmmaking: how director Perry Bhandal works solo using gen AI tools
items.excerpt: Indie filmmaker Perry Bhandal, who released the AI-generated feature 'Okay, It's Time To Go', gives a detailed first-hand account of what solo gen-AI feature production actually involves versus his 18-day conventional shoots.
items.rationale: A first-hand workflow account from a director who shipped a solo gen-AI feature, compared against his conventional 18-day shoots. It is practical detail, not opinion.

https://www.indiewire.com/news/breaking-.new_action: The Academy ruled the film ineligible for the Best Animated Feature Oscar (new official decision; the 10-26 card covered only AFM sales).
